issues.fact: The only mention of 'Chihiros SEA_LED (WRGB)' I found is in the supported-device list of an unofficial open-source Home Assistant/CLI control project. The project calls it a WRGB-type light and gives no specs, so there is no official product page, size range or retail listing to check it against.
The marine-light category at Shrimp Home, a Vietnamese shop, has no product called Chihiros SEA. The only Chihiros light it lists is the NOVA 1 Marine Coral Light.

alternatives.why: This is the Chihiros marine/coral light you can actually buy in Vietnam. Shrimp Home lists it at 5,345,000₫, which makes it the closest real match if 'SEA' was meant to be a saltwater light.
A marine LED that is a bit cheaper than the NOVA 1, at 4,610,000₫ on Shrimp Home.
A budget clip-on light for small reef tanks, listed at 600,000₫ on Shrimp Home.
